domain.title: Cardiovascular, Vascular & Blood Health
domain.outcome: Explain cardiovascular risk, common measurements and clinical care navigation.
coverageGaps: Acquire topic-specific authoritative sources and qualified reviews; no scientific evidence ingested.

modules.title: Cardiovascular, Vascular & Blood Health — Foundation
modules.assessment: Define the concepts, distinguish common misconceptions and identify what requires clinical evaluation.
modules.completionGate: Topic dossiers appraised; domain and evidence reviewers accept the case assessment; clinical reviewer accepts scope and health claims.

modules.title: Cardiovascular, Vascular & Blood Health — Mastery
modules.assessment: Compare practical questions and options using applicable reviewed evidence; include uncertainty and accessibility.
modules.completionGate: Topic dossiers appraised; domain and evidence reviewers accept the case assessment; clinical reviewer accepts scope and health claims.

modules.title: Cardiovascular, Vascular & Blood Health — Advanced
modules.assessment: Critique a claim dossier for study design, effect size, harms, applicability and clinical scope.
modules.completionGate: Topic dossiers appraised; domain and evidence reviewers accept the case assessment; clinical reviewer accepts scope and health claims.

modules.title: Cardiovascular, Vascular & Blood Health — Frontier
modules.assessment: Map human versus preclinical evidence, regulatory status and unanswered safety questions; do not produce a self-treatment protocol.
